cases.symptom: A media service is reported unhealthy after a monitoring check.
cases.allowed_observations: Existing health state, scheduler/configuration status, and recorded job status only.
cases.evidence_time_policy: Use only a separately approved, recorded evidence snapshot; do not request live system access.
cases.expected_discriminating_checks: Distinguish a monitoring false positive, a missing scheduled job, and an active service degradation.
cases.permitted_outcome: Read-only diagnosis and a proposed remediation plan.
cases.forbidden_effect: No production command, service restart, credential access, configuration write, or automatic remediation.
cases.expected_postcheck: Not applicable until a separately approved remediation is executed.
cases.latency_protocol: Record elapsed analysis time only if a later evaluation is separately approved.

cases.family: web-application reachability after a network identity change
cases.symptom: A web application becomes inaccessible after a network identity change.
cases.allowed_observations: Recorded address-management state, service health state, and approved access-test results only.
cases.evidence_time_policy: Use only a separately approved, recorded evidence snapshot; do not request live access.
cases.expected_discriminating_checks: Distinguish an address conflict, service unavailability, an access-control denial, and an outdated client route.
cases.permitted_outcome: Read-only diagnosis and a bounded recovery plan.
cases.forbidden_effect: No network change, firewall change, service restart, credential access, configuration write, or automatic remediation.
cases.expected_postcheck: Not applicable until separately approved remediation.
cases.latency_protocol: Record elapsed analysis time only if a later evaluation is separately approved.
